notes.title: 【0525】 Hunter Record & New Rhapsody Skills
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/95b0ad1b5ef7d8afec37735eeb467f90578a2932.png[/img]
Thank you for your support. It's been more than a month since the start of our EA. We've been receiving lots of feedback from players, saying that the game content isn't abundant, as well as suggestions on game optimizations.
Upon receiving the feedback, our devs hurried to fix bugs, optimized the gaming experience, and developed new content. In the new version, you will get to experience the Hunter Record and new Rhapsody skills. More fresh elements are on their way! Below is part of the new content in this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/5c4462a77db37c131c4306fc35a022a1bb0aeb96.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]New content[/b][/h3]
1. Hunter Record :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/22fc798059aca578e96df757bba20612cf7bcf50.png[/img]
a. Hunter's Mark
Has a chance to apply a Prey Mark on enemies when hitting them with Normal Attack.

b. Muscular Trapper
After Smashing, deploys a Hunting Trap where the character lands.

c.Variation Hunter
Whenever a Prey Marked enemy attacks, they will be Rended once.

d.Tear Up
Enemies with a Prey Mark have a chance to be Rended; Crowd Control always triggers the Rend effect.

To learn about more Record effects, please explore them in the game.

2. Added more skills to Rhapsody. Each character now has 17 skills.
[Lilya]
i. Crescendo Blade
ii. Charged Smash
iii. Quick Cut
iv. Staccato
v. Penetrating Note

[Evelyn]
i. Green Energy
ii. Watch Your Back
iii. Super Charger
iv. Bubble Energy
v. Downbeat Bubble

[Maz]
i.Explosive Iron Punch
ii. Mad Steps
iii. Stormy Punch
iv. Consecutive Bursts
v. Megalo Smash
vi. Neonized Fury

3. An new item, Record Boost, has been added, enabling an optional Record upgrade.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/89e31349221ddec87adbd7d02bed4127eb31cba7.png[/img]

4. Enriched the illustration system, added monster illustration descriptions, world view terminology descriptions, and action statistics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/ef62b256adc658ff08bca9ebbb6eea717ee1a93e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/be7a54160e8c49a9f374b4c2a1ee336c358a8825.png[/img]

5. Added plot information to the scenes.
6. Added the function of adjusting the brightness of the glare in the settings, players can adjust the intensity of light pollution by themselves.
7. Support for widescreen 4K resolution selection.
8. Add a new beginner's opening PV animation.


[h3][b]Optimizations:[/b][/h3]
1. Adjusted the benefits of character cultivation inside and outside the battlefield.
a. Adjusted the values in Life Composer
b. Empowered Records numerically during challenges
2. Optimized the experience in [Whisper-Difficult] and [Whisper-Crazy]
3. We conducted a small-scale decoration in Narcomelody, adding info guidance for the Resonancers.
4. The environment of the supply station on the battlefield will change as per different chapters.
5. Optimized the theme of the non-combat battlefield in the Turbulence Area


[h3][b]Bug Fixing:[/b][/h3]
1. Fixed the issue of interfaces overlapping on the right when selecting a stage.
2. Fixed some issues with Forcefield Record.
a. Fixed the issue where the damage caused by the Forcefield Mines triggered by 'Mine Deployment' (releasing Forcefield Mines after every 5 Active Attacks; the requirement is reduced to 3 times when having a Defensive Forcefield) was always at level 1.
b. Fixed the issue where [High Productivity] (lowers the DMG of the Forcefield Mine but the character can have 2 mines at the same time; 3 when their HP is below 50%) became ineffective under certain situations.
c. Fixed the issue where [Life Insurance] (With a Healing Forcefield, the character's HP is always considered to be below 50%) became ineffective under certain situations.
3.Fixed the sound effect error in the demonstration video of the Rhapsody「Keep the Pressure」of Maz.
4.Fixed the issue of Storm Record triggers abnormally.

Thank you again for your support for Neon Echo. Our next big version update will focus on new battlefields, new bosses, and new stories! Stay tuned!

notes.title: 【0427】Optimized battlefield rewards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/3aadad97252a12253955b7973f978f1fa14e6464.jpg[/img]
Regarding the recent feedback from players about the poor experience of reward selection during battlefield challenges, such as: 1. the monotony of rewards 2. too many battlefield-ineffective rewards 3. the difficulty of choosing between outside-battlefield and buff-granting resources, and 4. the lack of sense of growth after obtaining rewards by successfully defeating bosses, the dev team has made the following adjustments in response to the feedback:

[h3][b]Optimizations:[/b][/h3]
1.Optimized the roguelite experience:
- Increased the chance of obtaining Records; more growth-boosting battlefields, including more Records and other resources.
- Many more battlefields will provide various kinds of rewards now.
- Optimized the collocation of battlefields in a chapter. Resources that do not take effect during the challenge will not show up with the buff-granting ones.
- Improve the experience of character growth after defeating a boss; Neon Record, Resonancer Special, and other resources will be added and players will gain one of them upon victory; increased the drop rate of advanced resources.
- Battlefields that did not grant materials will do now; optimized the character development experience outside battlefields.
2.Optimized the backswing of Evelyn's Pew Pew Shooter.


[h3][b]Bug Fixing:[/b][/h3]
1.Fixed some description issues.
2.Fixed the bug that core embedding in Rhapsody might cause errors in skill casting.
3.Fixed the bug that Evelyn rendered flying units floating and they became unable to kill.
4.Fixed the issue with the animation problem when Icicle Worms were generated.
5.Fixed the bug that entries in Rhapsody were unstackable.
6.Fixed the bug that characters would have problems landing after casting their ult in mid air.
7.Fixed the bug that BGM was not played when players were viewing special plots in the Intimacy interface.
8.Fixed the bug that players could not meet requirements to clear certain battlefields.
9.Fixed the bug that Zephyr granted by [Wind Surging] would not make the character enter the Overload status.
10.Fixed the bug that [Link of Windcleaver] (when HP is over 80%, the number of Windcleaver +1) generated a wrong number of Windcleavers.
11.Fixed the bug that after Windcleaver's evolution (became Flame Windcleaver or Frosty Windcleaver), the character could not benefit from [Link of Windcleaver] (more Windcleavers) and Lv.2 Record Player · Storm (Keepsake; longer attack range and penetration).
12.Fixed the bug that the condition of obtaining [Burning Ice] (deal more damage to enemies whose stacks of Inferno Mark and Frostbite Mark both ≥3) was not the same as described in the Statue.

notes.title: 【0424】Improving the experience of character development
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/3aadad97252a12253955b7973f978f1fa14e6464.jpg[/img]

Regarding the issue of character development, which is rather grinding, the dev team has been continuously paying attention to player feedback and pushing forward content that can be implemented in a short period of time to improve players' experience. As we need to develop new content to address the issue of material consumption refunds for old players, the update of the optimization has been delayed, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and poor gaming experience caused to you all! The following is the content of this update:

[b][h3]Bug Fixing:[/h3][/b]
1.Fixed the bug that the notices of Label Development and in-battle communication went wrong.
2.Fixed the bug that Evelyn's Quick Jumps wasn't displayed correctly in Rhapsody.
3.Fixed the bug that after claiming victory, the character will be raised up to an abnormal area in the Turbulence Area (shaft type) 
4.Fixed the out-of-sync issue with the display of Lilya's Draw Slash in Rhapsody.
5.Fixed the bug that the icon of Evasion was wrongly displayed and skill icons disappeared.
6.Fixed the bug that some Elite enemies didn't move.
7.Adjusted the energy consumption of Evelyn's Bubble Carnival.
8.Fixed the bug that low-quality items from Blake's Shop had a chance to enter the Backpack and be brought into the headquarters.
9. Fixed some issues with abnormal situations that hindered the game from proceeding.

[b][h3]Optimizations:[/h3][/b]
1.Improving the experience of character development & materials acquisition in battle
2.Reduce the material consumption in Life Composer.
3.More guaranteed material drops after winning a battle.
4.Life Composer now has a reset function, increasing the player's level of freedom to develop characters with limited resources. (Old players can reset and have the consumed materials refunded)
5.Blacksnake Chamber of Commerce: added new items and improve the cost-effectiveness of item exchange, optimizing the purchasing experience.

6.After the update, the controller will support the re-binding of hotkeys, and players can adjust the key bindings of Variation skills according to their habits.
7.For Common difficulty, reduced the difficulty of the early stages of Chapters 1 and 2; optimized Record generation (the number of Records falls within a range); optimized the gaming experience when the character is not developed well enough in battle.
8.Optimized some descriptions of Notices, Records, and Difficulties.
9.Fixed the issue of character voice-overs being triggered too frequently & reduced the sound volume.
10.Optimized the graphic quality; after the update, anti-aliasing is bound to the graphic quality.

notes.title: 【0423】Fixed the bug that Storm and Forcefield Records could not be unlocked
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43916543/daf9b8b60ac7593947f126c8fd6f6605fde85989.jpg[/img]

[b]We are very sorry that due to a configuration error, most players were unable to unlock the Storm and Forcefield Records normally. Now, as long as you pass the Covonn Outer Ring (Chapter 1), you can have fun with these two powerful Records whose offensive and defensive capabilities are both strong (players who have already passed will automatically unlock them without the need to re-challenge).
[/b]

[b][h3]Bug Fixing:[/h3][/b]
1. Fixed the bug that Storm and Forcefield Records could not be unlocked.
2. Fixed the bug that after binding Interact and Exit to the same hotkey, players couldn't close the setting interface.
3. Fixed the issue with Frosty Windcleaver. Now it can correctly display its special effect and deal damage.
4. Optimized the effect description for Lv.1 Record Player · Storm
Original Version: Increases the duration of Overload. You can enter Overload status by squatting when you have over 5 stacks of Zephyr.
Optimized Version: 	Increases the duration of [color=keyword]Overload[/color]. You can enter [color=keyword]Overload[/color] status by squatting when you have over 5 stacks of [color=keyword]Zephyr[/color] *after the Evasion Rate is increased*.

5. Fixed the bug that Lilya's ult would be reset sometimes.
6. Fixed the bug that the character's death would increase the difficulty of the game.
7. Fixed the bug that enemies weren't teleported back to the platforms after falling from cliffs
8. Unify Christine's Mapping and Character Portrait.
9. Fixed the bug that Icicle Worms wouldn't break through the ground after being Smashed.
10. Fixed the issue with Overload's special effect. Now it won't overlap when the character possesses multiple Overload effects.
11. Fixed the bug that Lilya's Tempo Skill would knock flying monsters too high and couldn't kill them.

[b][h3]Optimizations:[/h3][/b]
1.Balance Adjustments:
This is the first balance update for the Neon Echo, and there will be more balance adjustments in the future. Feedback and suggestions are welcome.
- Lightning Record
Chain Lightning
Bounce Distance reduced: adjust to 75% of the original version

Point Discharge (cast Chain Lightning on the enemy when they launch an attack)
Triggering Range lowered: adjust to 75% of the original version

Mark & Run (Active Attack will apply a Thunder Mark on the enemy and Evasion will cause a Thunder Bolt to strike the marked target)
Triggering Range lowered: adjust to 83% of the original version

Electro-Charged (reduce enemy's resistance to Lightning Record)
Resistance Reduction: 12%/14%/16%/18%/20% ----> 14%/16%/18%/20%/22%
Stack Limit lowered: 10---->8

Thunderfall (Chain Lightning becomes Thunder Bolt and Thunder Bolt deals higher damage to enemies with 50% or higher HP)
Bonus DMG reduced: 30%/36%/42%/48%/60% -> 25%/30%/35%/40%/50%

- Power Record
Initial Crit DMG of missiles: 250%---->300%
Power Up (increases Crit Rate of your Omni-Damage)
5%/6%/7%/8%/10%---->8%/9%/10%/11%/12%

Suppression (Under Neonization status, Crit Hits have a chance to make enemies fear; increases Crit Rate for 3 sec for every enemy defeated)
Fear Rate increased: 20%---->25%
Crit Rate increased: 3%/3.5%/4%/4.5%/5%---->5%/5.5%/6%/6.5%/7%

Effect of Lv.2 Record Player · Power (Keepsake) (Execution deals massive damage to elite enemies and Lords)
DMG increased: 200 ----> 200 + 3% of target's Max HP

- Flame Record
Outrage (increases Active Attack DMG and Flame Record DMG)
DMG reduced: 30%/36%/42%/48%/60%---->25%/30%/35%/40%/50%

Overheated (doubles the stack number of Inferno Mark, each stack granting extra Fire Vulnerability)
Vulnerability effect weakened: 20%/24%/28%/32%/40%---->20%/23%/26%/29%/32%

- Storm Record
Now, you just need to pass the Covonn Outer Ring (Chapter 1) to unlock this Record (players who have already passed will automatically unlock them without the need to re-challenge).

Swift Blows (the more consecutive Active Attacks hitting the enemy, the higher the Omni-Damage will be)
Progressive DMG Increase in Combo: 3%/4%/5%/6%/7%---->3%/3.5%/4%/4.5%/5%

- Forcefield Record
Now, you just need to pass the Covonn Outer Ring (Chapter 1) to unlock this Record (players who have already passed will automatically unlock them without the need to re-challenge).

- Frostbite Record
Lethal Thaw (after the enemy is unfrozen, Frost Burst will be triggered. The more times the enemy is hit during the frozen state, the higher the base damage of Frost Burst will be.)
Frost Burst DMG of each stack increased: 12/14/16/18/24---->15/18/21/24/27

Change of Polar Wave's effect
Original Version: When an enemy takes damage from Frostbite Record, you have a chance of summoning a Melo-elf; Melo-elf creates a Glacial Field and triggers Frost Burst when it dies.
Optimized Version: When dealing Frostbite Record damage, you have a chance of summoning a Melo-elf; A Melo-elf creates a Glacial Field and triggers Frost Burst once every 2 sec.
Frost Burst DMG increased: 60/72/84/96/120---->80/95/110/125/140
Duration increased: 4s/4.5s/5s/5.5s/6s---->6s

Dangerous Track (a Melo-elf will follow you and trigger Frost Burst every 1 sec)
Frost Burst DMG increased: 60/72/84/96/120---->80/95/110/125/140
Duration increased: 4s/4.5s/5s/5.5s/6s---->10s

Glacial Protection (the character takes less melee DMG and releases Frost Burst every second; regenerates HP when it drops below 50%)
Frost Burst DMG increased: 60/72/84/96/120---->80/95/110/125/140
Duration increased: 3s---->4s
HP Regen decreased: 3/3/4/4/5---->2/2/3/3/4

Snowballing (for every Frozen enemy defeated, increases Frostbite Record DMG permanently)
Bonus DMG increased: 1%/1.2%/1.4%/1.6%/2%---->2%/2.2%/2.4%/2.6%/3%

- Venom Record
Stack Limit of Deadly Toxin: 6---->8; Stack Limit after the enhancement of Record Player · Venom (Keepsake): 8---->10

Venomspitter
DMG increased: 10/12/14/16/20---->15/18/21/24/30
HP increased: 20---->30

Datura
DMG increased: 30/36/42/48/60---->40/50/60/70/80
Summoning Limit increased: 2---->3
HP increased: 40---->60
Chomper
DMG increased: 60/72/84/96/120---->80/95/110/125/140
Damage against huge-sized enemies: fixed DMG---->200/220/240/260/300 + 2% of target's Max HP
Summoning Limit increased: 2---->3
HP increased: 40---->60

- Fusion of Records
The damage that has evolved through the fusion of (legendary) Records now will be buffed by both Records. For example, Flame Hurricane belongs to both Flame and Storm Records, and can simultaneously benefit from the attribute bonuses of both Records and trigger corresponding effects.

Lightning Swirl
Base DMG reduced: x1.2---->x1.1

Flame Hurricane
Base DMG reduced: x1.2---->x1.1

Flame Windcleaver
Base DMG reduced: x1.2---->x1.1

Frosty Windcleaver
Base DMG reduced: x1.2---->x1.15

Windy Frostburst
Base DMG reduced: x1.3---->x1.1

Electricfield Explosion
Initial Crit DMG increased: 225%---->250%

2. Fixed the issue with Legendary Record's DMG after evolution.
The damage of legendary Records after evolution will be buffed by both fused Records. For example, Flame Hurricane belongs to both Flame and Storm Records, and can simultaneously benefit from the attribute bonuses of both Records and trigger corresponding effects.

3. Hurricanes can now be reflected in Mayverine's battle scene.
After obtaining the Rejection of Wind (when a hurricane encounters an obstacle, it will be reflected and its duration +1 sec), the hurricane can bounce in the battle against Mayverine (the boss of Chapter 3).

4. Optimized some description issues.
5. Special Effects & Sound Effects Adjustment
a) Simplified the special effects of Maz's ult.
b) Simplified the Frozen effect to avoid display issues.
c) Fixed the icon display issue after Zephyr's Evasion Rate was increased.
d) Optimized the sound effects in the boss fight of Chapter 2
e) Optimized the display of non-upgradable nodes for Life Composer

notes.title: A Letter from the Producer - written before the release of the EA version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am LEON, the producer of "Neon Echo".

Straight to the point, I have been following the discussions in the community recently and found that the most mentioned topic was "if the price is reasonable, it's worth a try" In order to allow more players to try out the game, I decided to set the price at $14.99.

If you have watched our real-time demonstration of the game, I believe you can feel our sincerity. As a roguelite game, "Neon Echo" does not resemble a traditional roguelite game very much. But in fact, this is the basic idea of our project: investing more to continuously inject new elements into the genre, presenting more diverse role-playing elements, more trendy art styles, more dynamic combat methods, etc., exploring more possibilities that can be implanted into the genre.

After more than two years of development, the current version of the game has not yet reached my goal. Choosing to release the EA version also represents our higher expectations for the game. After finalizing the main concept, our team has made many different versions of gameplay with an emphasis on combat and rhythm, and has also made many attempts at the exploration of side-scrolling fun.

The lead programmer, who has cooperated with me for many years, has yelled at me and pushed me against the wall several times (just kidding), while the chief artist has intentionally or unintentionally played with the long sword of the character Lilya in front of me, all directly or indirectly questioning my soul: "How many poses should a demo contain?!"

One known truth in the industry is that the longer a demo is made, the higher the probability of the game being abandoned. The accumulation of pressure indeed made my bros in the game want to sacrifice me. Here, I sincerely thank my boss and the company for supporting my ideas.

In the EA version, you will see that the focus of the final gameplay leans more towards combat, because we do not want "rhythm" to become a burden on combat, but we hope that players can find it cool when playing along the rhythm, and unconsciously hitting the correct beat will make them feel like they are a pro. They can try to master it, or they can treat it like a hidden gem. Well, we made it a part of the roguelite design as well... A dynamic factor that is also controllable. The randomness will indeed make you hyped for a while.

$14.99, the price of a dish or two in a restaurant, is what it takes to make you happy for a long time. Although we are working very hard to make it better, the  gaming experience really depends on everyone's preferences. Thank you very much for taking the time to follow and then play this game. Although it is not exquisite enough, we have put a lot of effort into it. Players are friends to us, and this is a game that is meant for friends to play, so we should use our hearts to polish it. We are a small team and did not gain much publicity, but as long as there is a chance to make the game more fun and interesting, our passion for development will not be extinguished, and our exploration will not stop. We look forward to making a better experience for our friends, namely every player, every one of you. Thank you very much for your interest and willingness to try our game.

notes.title: A Letter from the Producer - written before Game first revealed
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Greetings. This is LEON, producer of Neon Echo.

I am writing this letter to you today, eager to share with you my thoughts and feelings as our game, which we have poured all our heart and soul into, will finally be available for early access testing and meet everyone on April 20th. 

We’ve been working hard over the past three years to create a truly unique and innovative game. We started with a simple goal: to explore the possibilities of roguelike games in a way that had not been done before. We wanted to create a game that was different from anything else out there. However, with so many amazing roguelike games already on the market, what other possibilities could we find? We spent three years looking for the answer.

The word 'roguelike' means that it can present changes all the time and the idea adapts to most games. This concept inspires us to take the core elements of roguelike games and inject them into a great amount of stuff. By adding and mixing all kinds of elements, we want to create a game that offers endless possibilities for exploration and discovery.

Our game, Neon Echo, stands on the foundation of traditional roguelike games, but with a twist. We have created a robust system that allows players to experiment with various combinations of weapons, abilities, and stats. This not only causes unprecedented synergy effects but also avoids monotonous battles.

In addition to the gameplay itself, we have placed great emphasis on the visual design and overall aesthetic of the game. We choose to move away from the standard pixel art style and opt for a more high-cost, cool anime style. This not only enhances the combat experience but also provides a fresh and visually stunning environment for players to immerse in.

We have also added a variety of playable characters with unique attack styles, energy systems, special talents, and skills. This not only provides players with multiple battle experiences but also satisfies their desire for role-playing.

We understand that creating a game that is both enjoyable and challenging is no easy feat. That's why we have incorporated a variety of mini-games to let everyone catch their breath during high-tension combat, such as dodging, parkour, and many more.

Finally, we have taken a bold step forward and created a gameplay that combines battles and rhythm. This idea originated from my personal experience. One day when I listened to music and danced to it, it suddenly struck me that we could add rhythms to battles so that hitting the beats would bring unexpected effects. We soon got down to it and realized this crazy idea. Now, players can empower their attack by hitting specific rhythm beats while listening to the BGM. They can choose to follow the beats to attack or completely ignore them. Either could be exciting!

Sure enough, we worry that our approach might not be accepted by roguelike fans, but we are eager to receive feedback from all those who try our game. We've invested more time and resources than anyone could've anticipated making Neon Echo the best it can be, and we hope that you can join us on this journey.

Thank you so much for taking the time to read my letter, and I look forward to seeing you all in the game in 11 days.

Sincerely,
LEON
